core_obligations: Pass to a surjective etale chart and read formal smoothness of the given morphism through the chart morphism.
Convert the lifting property into the vanishing that yields smoothness, reducing the cohomological input to the affine case.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose etale charts and reduce to the chart morphism.
Interpret the lifting property on the chart.
Establish the vanishing that gives smoothness.

difficulty_reason: The lemma contains the substantive implication of the infinitesimal lifting criterion in the algebraic-spaces setting: a morphism that is locally of finite presentation and formally smooth is smooth. The proof passes to a surjective etale chart, interprets formal smoothness of the chart morphism through the lifting property, and derives the vanishing needed for smoothness by reducing the cohomological input to the affine case. Passing the lifting condition through the chart and converting it into the vanishing statement is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 4598-4693.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the A side assumes a morphism of schemes; this side a morphism of algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none, both assert smoothness iff locally of finite presentation plus formal smoothness.

The A side's statement-plus-proof interval 3189-3282 coincides with public item tag/02H6, whose title names exactly that criterion, so the schemes side is already published; this side's interval 4586-4693 does not overlap it.
